lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Guess what, Teacher?

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Today is April Fool's Day!

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Naga and I are planning on fibbing at school.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: What would be good?

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: If you've got any nice ideas, tell us, hehe.
Actually, I have something to tell you.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: What is it?
I have a girlfriend, so I can't contact either of you anymore.
There's no response from Naga or Tia for a while.
Naga?
Tia?

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Psssh, you're lying♥

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Did you really think we'd fall for that?

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: You're just pulling our leg because it's April Fool's Day.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: You're adorable, Teacher♥

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: A real cutie.
No, it's true. Why would I lie about something like this?

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: All right, then tell us who it is.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Yeah, tell us!

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Then we'll believe you.
I think you might know her.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: We do?

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: What mutual acquaintances do we have with Teacher?

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: No way, I say you're lying!

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Still, I don't like this.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: If you really got a girlfriend,

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: we wouldn't be able to send you Bla messages whenever we wanted,

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: and we wouldn't be able to ask you for advice anymore.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Heck, we wouldn't even be able to go out for desserts with you!
That might be how things need to be from now on.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: What is this?

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: You're really sticking with this story...

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: I'm starting to believe it actually might be true.
Should I tell you her name?

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Yes, tell us.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Who is it?
Her first name is April.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Uh-huh, go on...
Naga and Tia are hanging on to every word I tell them.
And her last name... is Fool's.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: April...

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: ... Fool's.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Dang it!

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: You had me going for a second! ♥
April Fool's, hehehe♥

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Thank goodness you were making it up.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: That means we can still hang out with you! ♥

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: I can't believe it.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: We came to you asking for ideas on what to lie about,

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: and you ended up pulling the wool over our eyes.
Hehehehehe

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: But,

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: if you really did get a girlfriend,

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: I'd be super sad.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: So when that day comes, you have to tell us,

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: okay?

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Right, you have to tell us.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: We have to know who it is.
Hehe, okay.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Darn, we got carried away chatting with you and now our break time is over!

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: We'll talk to you later. Bye!
